---
title: "Today at a glance"
---

```{r}
source("R/weather.R")
source("R/dashboard.R")
snapshot <- read_dashboard_snapshot()
payload <- snapshot$payload
current <- payload$current
now <- dashboard_now(snapshot)
daily <- dashboard_today(snapshot)
hourly <- dashboard_hourly(hourly_frame(payload, snapshot$timezone), now, hours = 24)
best <- dashboard_best_hour(hourly, now, snapshot$timezone)
```

::: {.hero}
# Copenhagen weather

`r weather_description(current$weather)`

`r dashboard_freshness(snapshot)`
:::

Forecast for `r format(now, "%Y-%m-%d", tz = snapshot$timezone)`. Times are local to Copenhagen. Scroll the chart horizontally on smaller screens.

::: {.grid}
::: {.metric}
## Latest observation
`r dashboard_number(current$temp, "%.0f°C")`

Feels like `r dashboard_number(current$feels_like, "%.0f°C")`
:::
::: {.metric}
## Today
`r if (nrow(daily)) sprintf("%s / %s", dashboard_number(daily$max_temp, "%.0f°C"), dashboard_number(daily$min_temp, "%.0f°C")) else "Unavailable"`

High / low
:::
::: {.metric}
## Rain chance today
`r dashboard_number(daily$pop, "%.0f%%")`

Wind `r dashboard_number(daily$wind_speed, "%.0f m/s")`
:::
::: {.metric}
## Best outside today
`r dashboard_clock(best$time, snapshot$timezone)`

Score `r dashboard_number(best$score, "%.0f / 100")`

Remaining forecast hours only
:::
:::

## The next 24 hours

::: {.chart-scroll tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Scrollable forecast chart"}
```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-alt: "Temperature and rain probability over the next 24 forecast hours, in Copenhagen local time."
library(ggplot2)
if (!nrow(hourly)) {
  cat("No hourly forecast is available for the next 24 hours.\n")
} else {
  print(ggplot(hourly, aes(time, temp)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, colour = "#6ee7ff") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = pop), size = 2.5) +
    scale_colour_gradient(low = "#a7f3d0", high = "#60a5fa", limits = c(0, 100), name = "Rain chance %") +
    scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%a\n%H:%M", date_breaks = "6 hours", timezone = snapshot$timezone) +
    labs(x = "Copenhagen time", y = "Temperature °C") + dashboard_chart_theme())
}
```
:::

Sunrise today `r dashboard_clock(daily$sunrise, snapshot$timezone)` · Sunset today `r dashboard_clock(daily$sunset, snapshot$timezone)`
